ev.q: The patient, a boy aged 1 year, was born in Guizhou province.
Four isolates obtained and tested by real-time reverse transcription–polymerase chain reaction were identified as type 3 poliovirus.
Genetic sequencing of viral capsid VP1 coding region indicated that the four isolates diverged from type 3 Sabin strain by 22, 23, 22, and 24 nucleotides
Detection of a Highly Divergent Type 3 Vaccine-Derived Poliovirus in a Child with a Severe Primary Immunodeficiency Disorder
